description: This file defines the interface and data structures for interacting with the object database (ODB) in a version control system, including functions for reading, writing, and managing objects and sources.

classes.name: odb_source
classes.description: Represents a source of objects in the object database, such as the main directory or alternates, including metadata like path, locality, and private state.

classes.name: object_database
classes.description: Encapsulates access to objects in a repository, managing sources, transactions, and object storage details.

classes.name: object_info
classes.description: Structure used to request and receive information about a specific object, including type, size, and storage location.

classes.name: odb_write_stream
classes.description: Interface for streaming object data into the database during write operations.

methods.name: compute_alternate_path
methods.description: Computes the exact path of an alternate object store, returning NULL on error.

methods.name: odb_new
methods.description: Creates a new object database instance for a repository.

methods.name: odb_free
methods.description: Releases resources associated with an object database.

methods.name: odb_close
methods.description: Closes the database and releases resources, but allows reuse.

methods.name: odb_reprepare
methods.description: Reloads alternates and object sources to refresh accessible objects.

methods.name: odb_transaction_begin
methods.description: Starts a new transaction for batch object writes.

methods.name: odb_transaction_commit
methods.description: Commits a transaction, making objects visible.

methods.name: odb_find_source
methods.description: Finds a source by its directory path, returning NULL if not found.

methods.name: odb_find_source_or_die
methods.description: Finds a source by path or terminates if not found.

methods.name: odb_set_temporary_primary_source
methods.description: Replaces the primary source temporarily, returning the old source.

methods.name: odb_restore_primary_source
methods.description: Restores the primary source to a previous state.

methods.name: odb_add_submodule_source_by_path
methods.description: Adds a submodule's object store as a source.

methods.name: odb_for_each_alternate
methods.description: Iterates over all alternate sources, executing a callback.

methods.name: odb_for_each_alternate_ref
methods.description: Iterates over references of all alternate sources.

methods.name: odb_mkstemp
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in the primary alternate directory.

methods.name: odb_prepare_alternates
methods.description: Loads alternate sources from the configuration.

methods.name: odb_has_alternates
methods.description: Checks if the database has any alternates.

methods.name: odb_add_to_alternates_file
methods.description: Adds a directory to the on-disk alternates list.

methods.name: odb_add_to_alternates_memory
methods.description: Adds a directory to the in-memory list of alternates.

methods.name: odb_read_object
methods.description: Reads an object by ID, returning data and type info.

methods.name: odb_read_object_peeled
methods.description: Reads an object and its peeled version if applicable.

methods.name: odb_pretend_object
methods.description: Adds an in-memory object without writing to disk.

methods.name: odb_read_object_info_extended
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about an object.

methods.name: odb_read_object_info
methods.description: Retrieves basic info about an object.

methods.name: odb_has_object
methods.description: Checks if an object exists in the database.

methods.name: odb_freshen_object
methods.description: Refreshes the cache for an object.

methods.name: odb_assert_oid_type
methods.description: Asserts the object ID is of the expected type.

methods.name: enable_obj_read_lock
methods.description: Enables thread-safe locking for object reads.

methods.name: disable_obj_read_lock
methods.description: Disables thread-safe locking for object reads.
